records.title: A Polynomial-Time Quantum Algorithm for the Dihedral Coset Problem
records.abstract: This preliminary draft claims a polynomial-time quantum algorithm for the Dihedral Coset Problem. Combined with Regev's reduction of lattice problems to DCP and later improved reductions, it yields polynomial-time quantum algorithms for approximate SVP and LWE. The algorithm can tolerate a faulty sample rate 1/O(log n).
records.conclusion: The concluding corollary claims polynomial-time quantum algorithms for O(sqrt(n) polylog(n))-factor SVP and corresponding LWE instances.
